text:
emily: FYI we're seeing a spike in auth proxy 502/503s from eu-west1 starting ~10:12UTC. Affects token issuance for hosted and a subset of Dedicated customers. Investigating. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3165004321 1: investigating (initial)
raj: Oncall - joining. Initial hypothesis: recent ingress auth proxy config push caused upstream rate-limit exhaustion. I'll initiate rollback of that config in eu-west1.
kai: Commencing rollback (deploy id: rollback-2026-03-23-1018). Rolling back edge-group configs in eu-west1 now. ETA 5-8m.
ops-bot: Rollback job started on eu-west1-edge-group-a at 10:19UTC. Health checks streaming.
anita: Drafting support banner: "We're investigating intermittent auth and token failures in EU. Engineers are rolling back a config change; updates to follow." Recommend publish once we see initial metric improvement.
max: Escalating to PGT + account execs for affected customers. I'll prepare a brief to send to top impacted accounts.
emily: Published support banner and created internal incident note. Public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/3165004321 1. Internal runbook + notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/ingress-auth
ops-bot: Rollback completed on eu-west1-edge-group-a at 10:22UTC. Auth 5xxs down ~70% from peak.
raj: Putting in targeted fallback routing for priority routes to central auth cluster to finish mitigation while we validate.
kai: Fallback applied. ~12% of EU traffic shifted to central auth. Success rate for shifted traffic >99.5%, added latency ~25-35ms.
emily: Current status: rollback + targeted fallback in place. User-facing error rate reduced to <0.1% of requests. Monitoring for 30m window; if stable we'll open post-incident triage.
max: Notifying impacted customers and PG leads. Preparing customer follow-up comms.
anita: Support teams ack, triage doc added to incident.
incident-bot: Next automated update scheduled in 15m or on significant state change.
emily: Thanks all. If you see regressions, post here and tag @raj. We'll run a full RCA and post conclusions after the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
